verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de handles incorporation and post-incorporation filings, so a compliance calendar is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a calendar of upcoming filing deadlines or reminders sent before them. The Compliance API is only named as Enterprise-only, with no description of deadlines or reminders. The webhooks and appointment.completed events report completed events, not upcoming deadlines, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one
